links.outcome: Accuracy and completeness of ChatGPT answers versus ECCO guidelines rated by gastroenterologists
links.effect: 84.2% of replies had median accuracy ≥4; mean accuracy 3.87; mean completeness 2.24/3. Lowest ratings for malignancy screening and vaccination in immunosuppression and family planning.
links.quote: However, responses in specialist areas may deviate from evidence-based guidance and the replies need to give more firm advice.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's accuracy and completeness on real patient questions regarding inflammatory bowel disease without testing specific implementation guardrails or interventions.
